title: Jubilees 3 — Eden, the creation of Eve, and the fall

translation.sourceText: Jubilees — per-verse layered-witness reconstruction (Ge'ez-only witness for chapter 3; no Hebrew DSS, no Greek). Ge'ez per Charles 1902 PD + VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511.
translation.sourceLicense: Best-effort reconstruction; scholarly editions cited; English original to this project

paragraphs.text: ወበዕለት፡ ሳድስት፡ ሰዱስ፡ ሳምንት፡ ካልእት፡ አምጻእነ፡ በቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኀበ፡ አዳም፡ ኵሎ፡ አራዊተ፡ ወኵሎ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወኵሎ፡ አዕዋፈ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወኵሎ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ውስተ፡ ማይ፡ በበ፡ ዘመዱ፡ ወበበ፡ ምስሎሙ፡ አራዊተ፡ በዕለት፡ ቀዳሚት፡ ወእንስሳ፡ በዕለት፡ ካልእት፡ ወአዕዋፈ፡ በዕለት፡ ሣልስት፡ ወእለ፡ ይትሐወሱ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ በዕለት፡ ራብዕት፡ ወእለ፡ ይትሐወሱ፡ ውስተ፡ ማይ፡ በዕለት፡ ሐምስት፡ ወሰመዮሙ፡ አዳም፡ ኵሎሙ፡ በበ፡ ስማቲሆሙ፡ ወዘሰመዮሙ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ኮነ፡ ስሞሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-ʿəlat sādəstə sədus sāmənt kāləʾt ʾamṣaʾəna ba-qāla ʾəgziʾabəḥēr ḫaba ʾAdām kwəlo ʾarāwita wa-kwəlo ʾənəssā wa-kwəlo ʾaʿwāfa wa-kwəlo za-yətḥawwas lāʿla mədr wa-kwəlo za-yətḥawwas wəsta māy baba zamadu wa-baba məslomu ʾarāwita ba-ʿəlat qadāmit wa-ʾənəssā ba-ʿəlat kāləʾt wa-ʾaʿwāfa ba-ʿəlat śāləstə wa-ʾəlla yətḥawwasu lāʿla mədr ba-ʿəlat rābəʿt wa-ʾəlla yətḥawwasu wəsta māy ba-ʿəlat ḥaməst wa-samayomu ʾAdām kwəlomu baba səmātihomu wa-zasamayomu ʾəmənnehu kona səmomu

i18n.en: And on the sixth day of the second week we brought to Adam, by the word of the Lord, all the beasts and all the cattle and all the birds and everything that moves upon the earth and everything that moves in the waters, each after its kind and each after its likeness: the beasts on the first day, and the cattle on the second day, and the birds on the third day, and those that move upon the earth on the fourth day, and those that move in the waters on the fifth day. And Adam named them all, each by their names, and what he named them became their names.

paragraphs.text: ወበአምስቱ፡ ዕለት፡ እሉ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ መጽኡ፡ ኀበ፡ አዳም፡ በውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ከመ፡ ይሰምዮሙ፡ ወኮኑ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ በበ፡ ዘመዱ፡ ወአሐደ፡ አሐደ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲቱ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ወኮነ፡ አዳም፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘረከበ፡ ለርእሱ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ብእሲተ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-ʾaməstu ʿəlat ʾəllu kwəlomu maṣʾu ḫaba ʾAdām ba-wəsta ganata ʾEdom kama yəsammomu wa-konu kwəlomu baba zamadu wa-ʾaḥada ʾaḥada məsla bəʾəsitu məslēhu wa-kona ʾAdām bāḥtitu wa-ʾalbo zarakaba la-rəʾəsu məslēhu bəʾəsita

i18n.en: And in these five days they all came to Adam in the garden of Eden, that he might name them. And they were all, each after its kind, paired one and one with his mate beside him; but Adam was alone, and he found for himself no mate beside him.

paragraphs.text: ወይቤለነ፡ እግዚእ፡ ኢኮነ፡ ሠናየ፡ ይኩን፡ ሰብእ፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ ንግበር፡ ሎቱ፡ ረዳኤ፡ ዘይትከሐሎ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəbēlana ʾəgziʾ ʾi-kona śannāya yəkun sabʾ bāḥtitu nəgbar lottu radāʾē za-yətkaḥalo

i18n.en: And the Lord said to us: It is not good that the man should be alone; let us make a helper fit for him.

paragraphs.text: ወአንበሮ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላክነ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ሰዊመ፡ ወንዋመ፡ ወሰከበ፡ ወአንቅሐ፡ እምነ፡ ንዋሙ፡ በሰዱስ፡ ዕለት፡ በወርኅ፡ ካልእ፡ ወቦአ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ወአርአዮ፡ ወወፅአት፡ ብእሲት፡ ካልአዊት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾanbaro ʾəgziʾ ʾamlākəna lāʿlēhu sawima wa-nəwāma wa-sakaba wa-ʾanqəḥa ʾəm-nəwāmu ba-sadus ʿəlat ba-warḫ kāləʾ wa-boʾa ḫabēhu wa-ʾarʾayo wa-waḍʾat bəʾəsit kāləʾāwit

i18n.en: And the Lord our God cast upon him a deep sleep, and he slept; and he awoke from his sleep on the sixth day in the second month. And he came to him and showed her to him, and the woman came forth as another.

paragraphs.text: ወአውፅአ፡ ሎቱ፡ እምነ፡ ገበዋቲሁ፡ ዐጽመ፡ አሐደ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ብእሲት፡ እምዐጽሙ፡ ወመንበረ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ወመንበረ፡ አምሳለ፡ አዳም፡ ወወሀበ፡ ሎቱ፡ መጻተ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ፍጽፅረ፡ ለርእሱ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾawḍəʾa lottu ʾəm-nə gabawātihu ʿaṣma ʾaḥada wa-wəʾtu bəʾəsit ʾəm-ʿaṣmu wa-manbara śəgāhu wa-manbara ʾamsāla ʾAdām wa-wahaba lottu maṣṣata śəgāhu fəṣəṣəra la-rəʾəsu

i18n.en: And he took out for him one rib from his side, and that rib was the woman from his bone; and he built up the place of his flesh, and built up the likeness of Adam; and he gave him the substance of his flesh, that it might be closed over for him.

paragraphs.text: ወአንቅሐ፡ አዳም፡ እምነ፡ ንዋሙ፡ ወአንሥአ፡ ወርእየ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ወይቤ፡ ነየ፡ ይእቲ፡ ዐጽም፡ እምነ፡ ዐጽምየ፡ ወይእቲ፡ ሥጋ፡ እምነ፡ ሥጋየ፡ እንተ፡ ትሰመይ፡ ብእሲት፡ እስመ፡ እምነ፡ ምታ፡ ተወስደት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾanqəḥa ʾAdām ʾəm-nə nəwāmu wa-ʾansəʾa wa-rəʾəya bəʾəsita məslēhu qərruba wa-yəbē naya yəʾəti ʿaṣəm ʾəm-nə ʿaṣəməya wa-yəʾəti śəgā ʾəm-nə śəgāya ʾənta təssammay bəʾəsit ʾəsma ʾəm-nə mətā tawəsdat

i18n.en: And Adam awoke from his sleep and arose, and he saw the woman near him; and he said: This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called woman, because from her husband was she taken.

paragraphs.text: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ይኀድግ፡ ብእሲ፡ አባሁ፡ ወእሞ፡ ወይትሌጠ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲቱ፡ ወይከውኑ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ሥጋ፡ አሐደ፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu yəḫadəg bəʾəsi ʾabbāhu wa-ʾəmmo wa-yətlēṭa məsla bəʾəsitu wa-yəkawwənu kwəlomu śəgā ʾaḥada

i18n.en: Therefore a man shall leave his father and his mother and cleave to his wife, and they shall become one flesh.

paragraphs.text: በሳምንት፡ ቀዳሚት፡ ተፈጥረ፡ አዳም፡ ወወገንዱ፡ መሳርየ፡ ወበሳምንት፡ ካልእ፡ አርአያ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለመትኒ፡ እስመ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ለትትፈለጥ፡ ብእሲት፡ እምነ፡ ምታ፡ ሰብዐ፡ ዕለታተ፡ በዘወልደት፡ ተባዕተ፡ ወወልደት፡ አንስተ፡ ሰማንየ፡ ወእንዘ፡ ኢትትፈለጥ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ እስከ፡ ይትፌጸም፡ ሎሙ፡ መዋዕል፡ እሉ፡ በከመ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ለትባዕት፡ ሠላሳ፡ ዕለታተ፡ ወለአንስት፡ ስሳ፡ ዕለታተ፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-sāmənt qadāmit tafaṭra ʾAdām wa-waganədu masāriya wa-ba-sāmənt kāləʾ ʾarʾayā lottu la-matni ʾəsma la-zəntu taʾazaza la-tətfalaṭ bəʾəsit ʾəm-nə mətā sabʿa ʿəlatāta ba-zawaldat tabāʿta wa-waldat ʾanəsta samānya wa-ʾənza ʾi-tətfalaṭ bēta maqdas ʾəska yətfēṣṣam lomu mawāʿəl ʾəllu ba-kama taʾazaza la-tbāʿt śalāsā ʿəlatāta wa-la-ʾanəst səssā ʿəlatāta

i18n.en: In the first week was Adam created, and the rib was his wife also; and in the second week he showed her to him. Therefore on account of this it was commanded that the woman should be separated from her husband seven days for a male child and twice that for a female, and that she should not enter into the sanctuary until the days are completed for her: as it has been commanded, thirty days for a male, and sixty days for a female.

paragraphs.text: ወእምድኅረ፡ አርብዓ፡ ዕለታት፡ ለአዳም፡ ጊዜ፡ ፈጸመ፡ አንሰ፡ አምጻእነ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ከመ፡ ይትገበር፡ ወይዕቅባ፡ ወብእሲቱ፡ በሰማንያ፡ ዕለት፡ አምጻእናሃ፡ ወእምድኅረዝ፡ ቦአት፡ ውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmdəḫra ʾarbəʿā ʿəlatāt la-ʾAdām gizē faṣṣama ʾanəsa ʾamṣaʾəna kiyāhu wəsta ganata ʾEdom kama yətgabbar wa-yəʿqəbā wa-bəʾəsitu ba-samānya ʿəlat ʾamṣaʾənāhā wa-ʾəmdəḫrazə boʾat wəsta ganata ʾEdom

i18n.en: And after Adam had completed forty days in the land where he had been created, we brought him into the garden of Eden to till and keep it. And his wife we brought in on the eightieth day, and after that she entered the garden of Eden.

paragraphs.text: ወበእንተዝ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ በበ፡ ዕለታተ፡ ለዘወለደት፡ ለእንተ፡ ወለደት፡ ተባዕተ፡ ለትንበር፡ በርኵሰ፡ ሰብዐ፡ ዕለታተ፡ ወከመ፡ ሠላሳ፡ ዕለታት፡ ወካዕበ፡ ሠላሳ፡ ዕለታት፡ ለትንበር፡ በደመ፡ ንጽሐ፡ ወአልባቲ፡ ትግባእ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሥሙረ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ወውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ ኢትባእ፡ እስከ፡ ይትፌጸሙ፡ ዝንቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ እለ፡ ለተባዕት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-ʾəntazə taʾazaza lāʿla ṣəlāta samāy baba ʿəlatāta la-zawaladat la-ʾənta waladat tabāʿta la-tnabbar ba-rəkwsa sabʿa ʿəlatāta wa-kama śalāsā ʿəlatāt wa-kāʿba śalāsā ʿəlatāt la-tnabbar ba-dama nəṣḥa wa-ʾalbāti təgbāʾ kwəlo śmura qəddusa wa-wəsta bēta maqdas ʾi-təbāʾ ʾəska yətfēṣṣamu zəntu mawāʿəl ʾəllu la-tabāʿt

i18n.en: And on this account it was commanded on the heavenly tablets, day by day, concerning her who has given birth: if she bears a male, she shall remain in her uncleanness seven days, and again thirty days and thirty more days she shall remain in the blood of her purification; and she shall touch nothing that is holy, nor enter into the sanctuary, until these days are completed which are appointed for a male.

paragraphs.text: ወዘወለደት፡ አንስተ፡ ለትንበር፡ በርኵሰ፡ ሰማንየ፡ ዕለታተ፡ ሰሙናት፡ ክልኤ፡ ወወልደ፡ አምሳለ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ ሰዳሳ፡ ወሰዱስ፡ ዕለታት፡ በደመ፡ ንጽሐ፡ ወይከውን፡ ሰማንየ፡ ዕለታት፡ ኵሉ፡ ምስለ፡ ካልኡ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-zawaladat ʾanəsta la-tnabbar ba-rəkwsa samānya ʿəlatāta samunāt kələʾē wa-walda ʾamsāla qadāmi sadāsā wa-sadus ʿəlatāt ba-dama nəṣḥa wa-yəkawwən samānya ʿəlatāt kwəlu məsla kāləʾu

i18n.en: And if she bears a female, she shall remain in her uncleanness two weeks of days, after the manner of the first, and sixty-six days she shall remain in the blood of her purification — so that altogether they make eighty days with the other.

paragraphs.text: ወእምድኅረ፡ ፈጸመት፡ ዘንተ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ንጽሐ፡ አምጻእናሃ፡ ውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ እስመ፡ ቅድስት፡ ይእቲ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዕፅ፡ ዘውስተቴሁ፡ ይትከሰት፡ ቅዱስ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmdəḫra faṣṣamat zanta mawāʿəla nəṣḥa ʾamṣaʾənāhā wəsta ganata ʾEdom ʾəsma qəddəst yəʾəti ʾəm-nə kwəlu mədr wa-kwəlu ʿəḍ za-wəstatēhu yətkaśśat qəddusa

i18n.en: And when she had completed these days of purification, we brought her into the garden of Eden — for it is more holy than all the earth, and every tree that is planted in it is holy.

paragraphs.text: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ሥርዐት፡ ለዘወለደት፡ ለትባዕት፡ ወለአንስት፡ በበ፡ መዋዕሊሆሙ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኀጢአት፡ ከመ፡ ኢይትጋነኒ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ምድር፡ እንተ፡ ቅድስት፡ ለእግዚእ፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu taʾazaza śərʿat la-zawaladat la-tabāʿt wa-la-ʾanəst baba mawāʿəlihomu ʾəm-nə kwəlu ḫāṭiʾat kama ʾi-yətgāneni bēta maqdas zawəsta mədr ʾənta qəddəst la-ʾəgziʾ

i18n.en: On account of this the ordinance was appointed concerning her who bears a male and a female, in their appointed days, that they should keep apart from every uncleanness, lest the sanctuary which is on the earth, which is holy to the Lord, be defiled.

paragraphs.text: ወካዕበ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘያረኵስ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ መስተዋቅሕ፡ ለሞት፡ በከመ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ውስተ፡ ሥርዐት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-kāʿba kwəlu zayāraqəs bēta maqdas mastawāqəḥ la-mot ba-kama ṣəḥuf wəsta śərʿat

i18n.en: And moreover, everyone who defiles the sanctuary is liable to death, as it is written in the ordinance.

paragraphs.text: ወይነብር፡ አዳም፡ በውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ሰብዐ፡ ዓመተ፡ ለሰቢረ፡ ምድር፡ ወዕቀብታ፡ ወወሀብናሁ፡ ግብረ፡ ወመሀርናሁ፡ ኵሎ፡ ግብረ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ግቢሮተ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yənabbər ʾAdām ba-wəsta ganata ʾEdom sabʿa ʿāmata la-sabira mədr wa-ʿəqabtā wa-wahabnāhu gəbra wa-maharnāhu kwəlo gəbra zayəkawwən gəbirota

i18n.en: And Adam remained in the garden of Eden seven years tilling and keeping it; and we gave him work, and we taught him to do everything that was fitting to be done.

paragraphs.text: ወይትገበር፡ ግብረ፡ ወብእሲቱ፡ ትከይዶ፡ ወይከውና፡ ለትሕነጹ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ በውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yətgabbar gəbra wa-bəʾəsitu təkayyədo wa-yəkawwənā la-tḥənaḍḍu məslēhu ba-wəsta ganata ʾEdom

i18n.en: And he worked, and his wife labored with him; and they served together in the garden of Eden.

paragraphs.text: ወበፍጻሜ፡ ሰብዐቱ፡ ዓመት፡ እለ፡ ፈጸመ፡ በህየ፡ ሰብዐቱ፡ ዓመት፡ ፍጹመ፡ ወበካልእ፡ ወርኅ፡ በዐሡሩ፡ ወሰቡዑ፡ ዕለት፡ ለወርኅ፡ መጽአ፡ አርዌ፡ ምድር፡ ወቀርበ፡ ኀበ፡ ብእሲት፡ ወይቤላ፡ አርዌ፡ ምድር፡ ለብእሲት፡ በእንተ፡ ፍሬ፡ ዕፅ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ገነት፡ ይቤለክን፡ ኢትብልዓ፡ እምኔሃ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-fəṣṣāmē sabʿatu ʿāmat ʾəlla faṣṣama ba-həya sabʿatu ʿāmat fəṣṣuma wa-ba-kāləʾ warḫ ba-ʿaśru wa-sabuʿu ʿəlat la-warḫ maṣʾa ʾarwē mədr wa-qarba ḫaba bəʾəsit wa-yəbēlā ʾarwē mədr la-bəʾəsit ba-ʾənta fəre ʿəḍ zawəsta ganat yəbēlakən ʾi-təbəlʿā ʾəmənnehā

i18n.en: And at the end of the seven years which he had completed there, seven full years, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, the serpent came and drew near to the woman; and the serpent said to the woman: Has the Lord told you not to eat of the fruit of the tree that is in the garden?

paragraphs.text: ወትቤሎ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ፍሬ፡ ዕፅ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ገነት፡ ይቤለነ፡ እግዚእ፡ ብልዓ፡ ወእምነ፡ ፍሬ፡ ዕፅ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ማእከለ፡ ገነት፡ ይቤለነ፡ ኢትብልዓ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ወኢትግሥሥዎ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትሙታ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-təbēlo ʾəm-kwəlu fəre ʿəḍ zawəsta ganat yəbēlana ʾəgziʾ bəlʿa wa-ʾəm-nə fəre ʿəḍ zawəsta māʾkala ganat yəbēlana ʾi-təbəlʿā ʾəmənnehu wa-ʾi-təgśəśəwo kama ʾi-təmutā

i18n.en: And she said to him: Of all the fruit of the trees that are in the garden the Lord has told us to eat; but of the fruit of the tree that is in the midst of the garden he has told us not to eat of it, and not to touch it, lest we die.

paragraphs.text: ወይቤላ፡ አርዌ፡ ምድር፡ ለብእሲት፡ ኢመዊትከ፡ ትመውቱ፡ እስመ፡ የአምር፡ እግዚእ፡ ከመ፡ አመ፡ ትበልዑ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ይትከሠቱ፡ አዕይንቲክሙ፡ ወትከውኑ፡ ከመ፡ አማልክት፡ ወታአምሩ፡ ሠናየ፡ ወእኩየ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəbēlā ʾarwē mədr la-bəʾəsit ʾi-mawitkka təmawwətu ʾəsma yaʾammər ʾəgziʾ kama ʾama təbalʿu ʾəmənnehu yətkaśśatu ʾaʿəyəntikəmu wa-təkawwənu kama ʾamāləkt wa-taʾammərru śannāya wa-ʾəkuya

i18n.en: And the serpent said to the woman: You shall not surely die. For the Lord knows that on the day you eat of it your eyes will be opened, and you shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.

paragraphs.text: ወርእየት፡ ብእሲት፡ ከመ፡ ሠናይ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዕፅ፡ ለበሊዕ፡ ወሥሙር፡ ለአዕይንት፡ ለርእይ፡ ወአፍቀረቶ፡ ለፍሬሁ፡ ለበሊዕ፡ ወነሥአት፡ እምኔሁ፡ ወበልዐት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-rəʾəyat bəʾəsit kama śannāy wəʾtu ʿəḍ la-balʿiʿ wa-śmur la-ʾaʿəyənt la-rəʾəy wa-ʾafqaratto la-fərehu la-balʿiʿ wa-naśʾat ʾəmənnehu wa-balʿat

i18n.en: And the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and pleasant to the eyes to look upon, and she desired its fruit to eat; and she took of it and ate.

paragraphs.text: ወከደነት፡ ቅድመ፡ ሐፍረታ፡ ቈጽለ፡ በለስ፡ ወወሀበት፡ ለአዳም፡ ወበልዐ፡ ወተከሠተት፡ ዐይኑ፡ ወርእየ፡ ከመ፡ ዕሩቅ፡ ውእቱ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-kaddanat qədma ḥafratā quwāṣla balas wa-wahabat la-ʾAdām wa-balʿa wa-takaśśatat ʿaynu wa-rəʾəya kama ʿəruq wəʾtu

i18n.en: And first she covered her nakedness with a fig leaf, and then she gave it to Adam, and he ate; and his eyes were opened, and he saw that he was naked.

paragraphs.text: ወነሥአ፡ ቈጽለ፡ ወሰፈየ፡ ሎቱ፡ ቅንዐተ፡ ቈጽል፡ በለስ፡ ወከደነ፡ ሐፍረቶ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-naśʾa quwāṣla wa-safaya lottu qənʿata quwāṣl balas wa-kaddana ḥafrato

i18n.en: And he took a leaf and sewed for himself a covering of fig leaves, and covered his nakedness.

paragraphs.text: ወረገሞ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላክ፡ ለአርዌ፡ ምድር፡ ወተምዕዐ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ለዓለም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ragagamo ʾəgziʾ ʾamlāk la-ʾarwē mədr wa-tamʿəʿa lāʿlēhu la-ʿālam

i18n.en: And the Lord God cursed the serpent, and was angry with him for ever.

paragraphs.text: ወተምዕዐ፡ ላዕለ፡ ብእሲት፡ እስመ፡ ሰምዐት፡ ቃለ፡ አርዌ፡ ምድር፡ ወበልዐት፡ ወይቤላ፡ አብዝኆ፡ አብዝህ፡ ቍሕተ፡ ወምድረተ፡ ወበቍሕት፡ ትወልዲ፡ ውሉደ፡ ወኀበ፡ ምትኪ፡ ይኩን፡ ምሕያቅኪ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ይኲንነኪ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-tamʿəʿa lāʿla bəʾəsit ʾəsma samʿat qāla ʾarwē mədr wa-balʿat wa-yəbēlā ʾabəzəḫo ʾabzəh quḥta wa-mədrata wa-ba-quḥt təwallədi wəluda wa-ḫaba mətki yəkun məḥyāqki wa-wəʾtu yəkwannənaki

i18n.en: And he was angry with the woman, because she had hearkened to the voice of the serpent, and had eaten; and he said to her: I will greatly multiply your sorrow and your travail; in sorrow you shall bring forth children, and your desire shall be toward your husband, and he shall rule over you.

paragraphs.text: ወለአዳም፡ ይቤሎ፡ እስመ፡ ሰማዕከ፡ ቃለ፡ ብእሲትከ፡ ወበልዐከ፡ እምነ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዕፅ፡ ዘአዘዝኩከ፡ ኢትብላዕ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ርግምት፡ ምድር፡ በእንቲአከ፡ ሥርወ፡ ወዐጾቅተ፡ ታበቍል፡ ለከ፡ ወትብላዕ፡ እክሎ፡ ለገዳም፡ በሐፃጼ፡ ገጽከ፡ ትበልዕ፡ እክለከ፡ እስከ፡ አመ፡ ትገብእ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ እንተ፡ እምኔሃ፡ ተወሰድከ፡ እስመ፡ ምድር፡ አንተ፡ ወውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ትገብእ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-la-ʾAdām yəbēlo ʾəsma samāʿka qāla bəʾəsitka wa-balʿaka ʾəm-nə wəʾtu ʿəḍ zaʾazazku-ka ʾi-təbəlāʿ ʾəmənnehu rəgəmət mədr ba-ʾəntiʾaka śərwa wa-ʿaḍoqəta tābaqwəl laka wa-təbəlāʿ ʾəklo la-gadām ba-ḥaḍāḍē gaṣṣəka təbəlāʿ ʾəklaka ʾəska ʾama təgabbəʾ wəsta mədr ʾənta ʾəmənnehā tawasadkka ʾəsma mədr ʾanta wa-wəsta mədr təgabbəʾ

i18n.en: And to Adam he said: Because you have hearkened to the voice of your wife and have eaten of that tree which I commanded you not to eat of it, cursed is the ground for your sake; thorns and thistles shall it bring forth for you, and you shall eat the herb of the field. In the sweat of your face shall you eat your bread, until you return to the ground from which you were taken; for earth you are, and to the earth you shall return.

paragraphs.text: ወገብረ፡ ሎሙ፡ አልባሰ፡ ማእሰ፡ ወአልበሶሙ፡ ወፈነዎሙ፡ እምነ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-gabra lomu ʾalbāsa māʾsa wa-ʾalbasomu wa-fanawomu ʾəm-nə ganata ʾEdom

i18n.en: And he made for them garments of skin and clothed them; and he sent them forth from the garden of Eden.

paragraphs.text: ወወልሐ፡ አዳም፡ በዕለት፡ እንተ፡ ወፅአ፡ እምነ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ዕጣነ፡ ዘሠናይ፡ መዓዛ፡ መልአን፡ ወቅለድፍሬና፡ ወቀርፈ፡ ፊቅማ፡ በነግህ፡ ምስለ፡ ወፅአቱ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ በዕለት፡ እንተ፡ ከደነ፡ ሐፍረቶ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-walḥa ʾAdām ba-ʿəlat ʾənta waḍʾa ʾəm-nə ganata ʾEdom ʿəṭāna zaśannāya maʿāzā malʾan wa-qələdəfrenā wa-qarfa fiqmā ba-nagə̄h məsla waḍʾatu la-ḍaḥay ba-ʿəlat ʾənta kaddana ḥafrato

i18n.en: And on the day that Adam went forth from the garden of Eden, he offered as a sweet-smelling savor an incense — frankincense, galbanum, stacte, and spices — in the morning with the rising of the sun, on the day he covered his nakedness.

paragraphs.text: ወእምይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ተአተወ፡ አፉሆሙ፡ ለኵሉ፡ አራዊት፡ ወእንስሳ፡ ወአዕዋፍ፡ ወዘይትሐወስ፡ ወዘይትዐለው፡ እምነ፡ ተናግሮ፡ እስመ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ በበ፡ ቃሎሙ፡ ይትናገሩ፡ አሐደ፡ ምስለ፡ ካልኡ፡ በቃል፡ አሐዱ፡ ወልሳን፡ አሐዱ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəm-yəʾəti ʿəlat taʾatawa ʾafuhomu la-kwəlu ʾarāwit wa-ʾənəssā wa-ʾaʿwāf wa-zayətḥawwas wa-zayətʿalaw ʾəm-nə tanāgəro ʾəsma kwəlomu baba qālomu yətnāgaru ʾaḥada məsla kāləʾu ba-qāl ʾaḥadu wa-ləssān ʾaḥadu

i18n.en: And on that day the mouths of all the beasts and the cattle and the birds, and of all that moves and all that creeps, were stopped from speaking — for they had all been speaking with one another, each with its fellow, in one voice and one tongue.

paragraphs.text: ወአውፅአ፡ እምነ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ኵሎ፡ ሥጋ፡ ዘሀሎ፡ ውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ወተዘርዉ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ ኵሉ፡ በበ፡ ዘመዱ፡ ወበበ፡ ምስሎሙ፡ በምድር፡ ዘተአዘዘ፡ ሎቱ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾawḍəʾa ʾəm-nə ganata ʾEdom kwəlo śəgā zahallo wəsta ganata ʾEdom wa-tazarwə kwəlu śəgā kwəlu baba zamadu wa-baba məslomu ba-mədr za-taʾazaza lottu

i18n.en: And he sent forth from the garden of Eden all flesh that was in the garden of Eden; and all flesh was scattered, each after its kind and each after its likeness, in the land that was appointed for it.

paragraphs.text: ወለአዳም፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ ወሀቦ፡ ይከድን፡ ሐፍረቶ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ አራዊት፡ ወእንስሳ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-la-ʾAdām bāḥtitu wahabō yəkaddən ḥafrato lāʿla kwəlu ʾarāwit wa-ʾənəssā

i18n.en: And to Adam alone, of all the beasts and cattle, did he give the covering of nakedness.

paragraphs.text: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ዘይከድኑ፡ ሐፍረቶሙ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ የአምሩ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ወአላበስዎሙ፡ ከመ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ወአላበሰ፡ ሐፍረቶሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu taʾazaza lāʿla ṣəlāt zayəkadnu ḥafratomu kwəlomu ʾəlla yaʾammərru fətḥa wa-ʾallabasəwomu kama ʾaḥzāb wa-ʾallabasa ḥafratomu

i18n.en: On account of this it was commanded on the heavenly tablets that all who know the law should cover their nakedness, and should not be uncovered as the nations are uncovered.

paragraphs.text: ወእምነ፡ ርእሰ፡ ካልእ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ሐነጹ፡ ሎሙ፡ ቤተ፡ በምድር፡ ዘውስቴታ፡ ተፈጥረ፡ አዳም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəm-nə rəʾəsa kāləʾ ʾiyobēləwu ḥanaḍṣu lomu bēta ba-mədr zawəstatēhā tafaṭra ʾAdām

i18n.en: And at the beginning of the second jubilee they built for themselves a house in the land where Adam had been created.

paragraphs.text: ወአዳም፡ የአምር፡ ለብእሲቱ፡ ኤዋ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ቃየል፡ ወአቤል፡ ወለክልኤሆሙ፡ አንስት፡ አሐቲ፡ ኣዋን፡ ወአሐቲ፡ አዙራ፡ ወወሀብናሁ፡ ለቃየል፡ ኣዋን፡ እኅቶ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወሀብናሁ፡ ለሴት፡ አዙራ፡ እኅቶ፡ ብእሲተ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾAdām yaʾammər la-bəʾəsitu ʾEwa wa-waladat lottu Qāyāl wa-ʾAbēl wa-la-kələʾēhomu ʾanəst ʾaḥati ʾAwān wa-ʾaḥati ʾAzurā wa-wahabnāhu la-Qāyāl ʾAwān ʾəḫto bəʾəsita wa-wahabnāhu la-Set ʾAzurā ʾəḫto bəʾəsita

i18n.en: And Adam knew Eve his wife, and she bore him Cain and Abel; and for the two of them there were sisters, one Awan and one Azura. And we gave Awan to Cain as his sister-wife, and we gave Azura to Seth as his sister-wife.

paragraphs.text: ወቃየል፡ ቀተሎ፡ ለአቤል፡ እስመ፡ ይትገበር፡ መሥዋዕቱ፡ ወመሥዋዕተ፡ አቤልሰ፡ ኢተገብረ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-Qāyāl qatalo la-ʾAbēl ʾəsma yətgabbar maśwāʿtu wa-maśwāʿta ʾAbēlsa ʾi-tagabra

i18n.en: And Cain killed Abel; for Abel's sacrifice was accepted, but Cain's sacrifice was not accepted.

paragraphs.text: ወእምድኅረዝ፡ መውት፡ ኮኖ፡ ለአዳም፡ ጊዜ፡ ፈጸመ፡ ምልአ፡ ዓመቱ፡ ወእንሰ፡ ዘመነ፡ መውት፡ ይከውን፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmdəḫrazə mawt kono la-ʾAdām gizē faṣṣama mələʾa ʿāmatu wa-ʾənsa zamana mawt yəkawwən

i18n.en: And after this, when Adam had completed the fullness of his days, death came upon him; and there came to be a time for death.
